visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a black coat over a cream-colored knitted sweater, stands on a city street at night. She uses a wooden stick to lift a golden-brown round snack into her wide-open mouth. Behind her are vertical signs for 'Ten grains' and 'Navy Curry'. Yellow bold slogan text is overlaid in the center. (2) The woman chews the food with a delighted expression, looking directly into the lens with squinted eyes and a wide smile. She begins a playful shoulder-shaking dance. Colorful animated 'Happy' text stickers pop up around her against the backdrop of the brightly lit night market and distant pedestrians. (3) She continues her lighthearted dance, moving her fists in a rhythmic punching motion while holding a white paper bag of snacks. Animated 'QQ' bubbles appear above her head. She laughs heartily, covering her mouth with her right hand. The environment is vibrant with neon lights and urban market stalls.
